observations.observation: Page title and head metadata differ. The original's title is 'Bather | Quality Men's Surf and Swimwear | Made in Canada', and its head carries 25 meta tags (og:, twitter:, Shopify wallet/checkout) plus 3 JSON-LD blocks. The AI-built page's title is 'Bather Trunk Company — Men's Surf & Swim', with only 3 meta tags (charset, viewport, description) and no JSON-LD.

tags.value: changed: rich social and json-ld meta becomes minimal meta

observations.observation: A thin announcement bar at the very top holds the centered uppercase text 'FREE SHIPPING ON ORDERS OVER $150 USD'. In the original it is light grey (rgb(239,239,239)) with dark text. In the AI-built page it is dark navy (rgb(29,58,74)) with white text.

tags.value: changed: light grey top strip becomes dark navy strip

observations.observation: Header layout differs. The original overlays the header on the hero image, with a centered 115px logo (white and dark variants stacked in the same spot) and a pale cart icon at the far right. The AI-built header is a solid three-part bar: a 95x34 logo on the left, four uppercase nav links in the center (SHOP, ABOUT, JOURNAL, STOCKISTS), and plain-text SEARCH and CART links on the right, with no icons.

tags.value: changed: overlay logo and cart icon become solid three-part bar
changed: centered uppercase text nav links in header

observations.observation: The original has a hidden mega-menu in the DOM with 296x184 'SS21 Style Guide' images. The AI-built page has a single plain nav ul with no dropdown or mega-menu markup.

tags.value: dropped: hidden mega-menu with style guide images

observations.observation: Hero structure differs. The original hero is a full-bleed 1440x856 image area (it rendered blank, with a broken-image icon) with only a small 'SHOP NOW' text link at the left. The AI-built hero is a two-column split on a warm beige rgb(244,241,236) band: on the left an eyebrow, the h1, a grey paragraph and two CTAs; on the right a 441x552 image that renders as a flat grey rectangle.

tags.value: changed: full-bleed image becomes two-column beige hero

observations.observation: The h1 differs. The original's single h1 is empty and invisible (15px, weight 400, white). The AI-built page's single h1 is 'SPRING/SUMMER '21' at 72px, weight 700, near-black rgb(17,17,17), and wraps onto two lines in a 623px column.

tags.value: changed: empty invisible h1 becomes large bold visible h1

observations.observation: Neither heading outline is strictly sequential, with h3s appearing before the h2s. The original puts an h3 eyebrow before each h2 (19 h2s, 9 h3s). The AI-built page goes from the h1 straight to three h3s before its first h2, then has 8 h2s and 3 footer h4s.

tags.value: kept: non-sequential outline with h3 before h2

observations.observation: Both pages use small uppercase, letter-spaced eyebrow labels above section headings (e.g. NEW ARRIVALS, SUSTAINABILITY, MADE IN CANADA). The original marks these up as h3 elements; the AI-built page uses grey p elements.

tags.value: kept: uppercase letterspaced eyebrow above headings

observations.observation: Each page uses one sans-serif family throughout, but a different one. The original uses Calibre (621 elements) with a system-ui/avenir/helvetica fallback stack. The AI-built page uses Helvetica Neue (204 elements) with Helvetica/Arial fallbacks.

tags.value: changed: calibre becomes helvetica neue stack

observations.observation: Section headings differ. The original sets them in uppercase, wide letter-spacing, light weight 400, with a 23px h2. The AI-built page uses bold weight 700, sentence-case 38.4px h2s with tight tracking that wrap to two lines in half-width columns.

tags.value: changed: uppercase light headings become bold sentence-case large h2s

observations.observation: The type scale's range differs. The original's sizes stay close together: a 15px h1, 23px h2s and 15px body. The AI-built page jumps from a 72px h1 to 38.4px h2s, about 24px card h3s, and about 12px letter-spaced micro-labels.

tags.value: changed: narrow size range becomes wide size contrast

observations.observation: Body text differs: 15px with a 24.75px line-height in the original, and 16px with a 25.6px line-height in the AI-built page. Both use sentence case with grey secondary text: rgb(106,106,106) in the original, rgb(102,102,102) in the AI-built page.

tags.attribute: body text size and line height
tags.value: changed: 15px 1.65 becomes 16px 1.6

observations.observation: Both palettes are mostly neutral on a white body, but the colors differ. The original uses near-black rgb(28,27,27), grey text and a light-grey footer, with saturated color coming only from photography. The AI-built page uses near-black rgb(17,17,17) and adds a warm beige rgb(244,241,236), navy rgb(29,58,74), and one orange rgb(217,105,43) product swatch.

tags.value: changed: neutral grey and white gains beige navy and orange

observations.observation: Images do not display real photography on either page, in different ways. In the original, many images failed to load (0x0 rects, broken icons), leaving blank white gaps of about 300–500px between sections. In the AI-built page, the images have a natural size of 1x1px and render as flat colored blocks (grey, off-white, tan, brown, slate).

tags.value: changed: broken images become flat colored blocks

observations.observation: Both pages have a row of three equal-width tiles, with different content and fills. The original's tiles (SUSTAINABILITY, GIFT CARDS, EXCELLENT ADVENTURES) are 440px-wide squares in muted slate, taupe and tan with white text. The AI-built tiles (Bandana towels, Camp shirts, SS21) are 355x220 beige boxes on white with dark text.

tags.value: changed: colored square tiles become beige boxes with dark text

observations.observation: Tile contents are stacked differently. Each original tile has a small eyebrow, an uppercase title and a white rectangular button (LEARN MORE / BUY NOW / READ), all centered near the bottom. Each AI-built tile has an h3, a one-line description and an underlined text link, bottom-weighted and left-aligned.

tags.value: changed: centered title and button become left-aligned text with link

observations.observation: Corners are square throughout both pages. The original has 622 elements at radius 0, 9 pill-shaped and 1 small radius. The AI-built page has 196 at radius 0, 8 in the 1–7px bucket and no pills. Both primary buttons have a 0px radius.

tags.value: kept: square corners everywhere

observations.observation: The primary button on both pages is a solid near-black rectangle with white uppercase letter-spaced text. The original uses it for ALL POSTS and SUBSCRIBE; the AI-built page uses it for SHOP NOW (13px 28px padding) and SUBSCRIBE.

tags.value: kept: solid near-black uppercase rectangle button

observations.observation: On both pages, secondary CTAs are uppercase text links with a thin underline instead of button chrome (e.g. LEARN MORE, SHOP THE FULL COLLECTION, READ MORE). The AI-built links are bold, and the original's LEARN MORE is grey.

tags.value: kept: uppercase underlined text links

observations.observation: The 'SHOP THE FULL COLLECTION' link is placed differently. The original sets it centered under a centered 'SS21 AVAILABLE NOW' h2, followed by centered SHOP ACCESSORIES / VIEW ALL labels. The AI-built page puts it in the hero as the secondary CTA next to SHOP NOW.

tags.value: changed: centered collection link becomes hero secondary cta

observations.observation: The sustainability section differs. The original is a two-column split on white: a large lime-green recycled-garment image on the left, and an eyebrow, heading, sentence and underlined link on the right, vertically offset. The AI-built version is a full-width dark-navy band with white text, a white-filled LEARN MORE button, and a pale 524x393 image block on the right.

tags.value: changed: white two-column split becomes dark navy band

observations.observation: Image-and-text split sections alternate sides down the AI-built page (sustainability, Made in Canada, gift cards, ethos), along with alternating navy, white and beige backgrounds. The original has only one such split.

tags.value: added: alternating navy white and beige bands with alternating splits

observations.observation: The three-product featured section is presented differently. In the original, only three 'VIEW' labels render at column centers, with no visible images or titles, leaving gaps of about 500px. The AI-built page has a beige band with a 38.4px 'Featured products' h2, a right-aligned SHOP ALL link, and three 352x453 cards with 1px light borders.

tags.value: changed: bare view labels become bordered cards on beige band

observations.observation: Product imagery differs. The original references 750x960 portrait product photo crops, which did not render. The AI-built cards use solid color squares (tan, orange, near-black) with a centered white category label, a small attribute tag and an h3 title below.

tags.value: changed: unrendered photo crops become solid color squares with labels

observations.observation: Press quotes differ. The original has one centered, larger sentence-case pull-quote with straight quotes and a '— Business Insider' attribution, without blockquote markup. The AI-built page has six italic grey quotes in curly quotation marks, each in a figure/blockquote, with no cite or figcaption.

tags.value: changed: single pull-quote becomes six blockquote figures

observations.observation: Press logos are laid out differently. The original has a single row of six 150x113 logos on a 240px pitch, mostly grey with Business Insider in black. The AI-built page has a 3x2 grid of 140x105 grayscale logos above their quotes on beige, under a centered 'In the press' heading, ending with a centered PRESS link.

tags.value: changed: single logo row becomes grid on beige

observations.observation: Image alt text differs. The original's press logos have empty alt attributes, and 1 image is missing alt entirely. The AI-built press and payment logos have descriptive alt text (e.g. 'GQ', 'The New York Times'), and no images are missing alt.

tags.value: changed: empty alts become descriptive alts

observations.observation: The 'Our Ethos' section differs. The original is a full-width slate band with centered white text-shadowed copy in a narrow column of about 380px. The AI-built version is a left/right split: a placeholder image on the left, and on the right an h2 with a bulleted list of three paragraph-length items, the page's only bulleted body list.

tags.value: changed: centered text band becomes split with bulleted list

observations.observation: The '1% for the Planet' badge sits in a different place. In the original it is a 120x150 image in the footer's second column. In the AI-built page it is a small 72x54 crop in the ethos section above two underlined links.

tags.value: changed: footer badge moves into ethos section

observations.observation: Both journal sections are a three-column row of 3 article elements, each with a heading, an excerpt and a read-more text link.

tags.value: kept: three-column article row with read more

observations.observation: The original's journal articles have 380x224 thumbnail slots (blank) and uppercase headings with truncated '...' excerpts. The AI-built articles are text-only with no thumbnails.

tags.value: dropped: article thumbnails and truncated excerpts

observations.observation: The AI-built journal section has extra structure: a heading row with a right-aligned READ link, and a 2px black rule on top of each article.

tags.value: added: heading row link and top rule on articles

observations.observation: The 'ALL POSTS' control differs: a solid near-black button in the original, and a left-aligned underlined text link below the grid in the AI-built page.

tags.value: changed: solid black button becomes underlined text link

observations.observation: The journal dateline uses different punctuation. The original writes 'Toronto, ON — April 15, 2021 —' with em-dashes, and the page has 10 em-dashes in total. The AI-built page writes 'TORONTO, ON · APRIL 15, 2021' as an uppercase eyebrow on the middle article only, and the page has 1 em-dash.

tags.value: changed: em-dash dateline becomes uppercase dot eyebrow

observations.observation: Copy on both pages is dated to 2021 (SS21 / Spring/Summer '21, April 15 2021, © 2021) and centers Canadian, Toronto-made positioning ('MADE IN CANADA').

tags.value: kept: same 2021 dated items and copyright notice

observations.observation: Copy on both pages is in a brand voice led by sustainability ('Made with 100% recycled materials', 1% for the Planet), with no exclamation marks and similar length: 508 words in the original, 464 in the AI-built page. The AI-built copy leans on short declarative fragments.

tags.value: kept: sustainability-led voice without exclamation marks

observations.observation: Both pages offer 10% off for signing up, with the email signup placed differently. In the original it sits in the footer: a hairline-bordered input with a black SUBSCRIBE button stacked below it. In the AI-built page it is a separate centered beige band headed 'Get 10% off your first order', with a 333px black-bordered input joined inline to a black SUBSCRIBE button and no visible label.

tags.value: changed: footer column form becomes centered beige band with inline button

observations.observation: The footers differ. The original's is a light-grey (239) band with four columns: About Bather, the 1% badge, More Info and the Let's be friends signup, with grey text. The AI-built footer is a near-black block with three columns (brand blurb, CUSTOMER, MORE), white bold h4 headings and light-grey links.

tags.value: changed: light grey four-column footer becomes near-black three-column footer

observations.observation: Both footers end with a copyright line ('© 2021 Bather Trunk Company') and a row of eight payment-method badges.

tags.value: kept: payment badge row in footer

observations.observation: Social links differ. The original shows four small grey inline SVG icons (Facebook, Instagram, Pinterest, Tumblr), and the page has 26 SVGs. The AI-built page uses plain text links (Facebook, Instagram, Pinterest, Lifestyle) and has 0 inline SVGs.

tags.value: changed: icon glyphs become plain text links

observations.observation: Page dimensions and margins differ. Both pages are 1440px wide. The original is 6069px tall, with full-bleed hero and tiles at 30px margins and varying insets (90px, 80px, 215px). The AI-built page is 5841px tall, with a consistent centered column of about 1104px (168px side margins) and full-width bands about 400–675px tall.

tags.value: changed: varying insets become centered 1104px column in full-bleed bands

observations.observation: Text alignment leans differently. The original centers much of its content (tiles, SS21 block, pull-quote, ethos band). The AI-built page left-aligns most section copy in half-width columns and centers only the announcement bar, press section and newsletter.

tags.value: changed: centered content becomes left-aligned half-width columns

observations.observation: Layout mechanics differ. The original relies on flexbox (20 flex containers, 1 grid) with div-heavy markup (203 divs). The AI-built page uses 13 grid and 21 flex containers with 39 divs.

tags.value: changed: flexbox and divs become flex plus grid

observations.observation: Semantic landmarks differ. The original has 15 header, 4 nav, 1 aside, 12 section and 3 article elements, with no figure or blockquote. The AI-built page has 1 header, 1 nav, 10 sections, 3 articles, 6 figures and 6 blockquotes, with no aside. Both have 1 main and 1 footer.

tags.value: changed: many headers and asides become single header and sections

observations.observation: Both pages use semantic named CSS classes rather than utility classes (tailwind-like fraction 0), at very different volumes: 958 class uses and 265 unique names in the original, 82 and 33 in the AI-built page.

tags.value: kept: custom class names rather than utility classes

observations.observation: Page weight differs. The original has 90 scripts, 9 stylesheets, 16 style tags and 74 inline style attributes (a themed Shopify build). The AI-built page has 0 scripts, 1 stylesheet and 9 inline style attributes.

tags.value: changed: many scripts and stylesheets become single inline style

observations.observation: Neither page uses gradients or backdrop blur, but motion and effects differ. The original has 184 transitions, 7 animations, 25 transforms and 5 box-shadows. The AI-built page has 7 transitions and no animations, transforms or shadows, relying on flat color bands and hairlines.

tags.value: changed: many transitions and animations become fewer transitions

observations.observation: Interactive controls and ARIA usage differ: the original has 6 buttons, 7 inputs and 37 ARIA attributes; the AI-built page has 1 button, a single email input and 3 ARIA attributes.

tags.value: changed: heavy aria becomes minimal aria

observations.observation: The original uses responsive image markup: 9 picture and 10 source elements, lazy-load 1x1 placeholders, and Shopify CDN size suffixes (_115x, _1600x, _750x960_crop_center). The AI-built page uses plain img tags.

tags.value: dropped: responsive picture and source elements
